security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Network operations, from the terminal to the change window.
bundle.longDescription: Nocturne is one application for the daily work of a network engineer: terminal sessions, discovery, monitoring, versioned configuration backups, safe configuration changes with approval and rollback, topology, IP address management, a virtual lab, and an assistant that can use all of it.
